liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer says this Looks Like Rain rivals the finest versions played later in Europe [15]
- **Loser** (1 review): The reviewer singles out Loser from this show as a favorite [4]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer remembers Casey Jones seeming to go on forever [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-03-27.135871.sbd.miller.flac48** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 187 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1972-03-27.132366.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 24 songs; 187 min; rated 3.58/5 by 12 [2]. Said about its sound: Soundboard mix is praised as amazing, especially Kreutzmann's drums, which hit hard; Soundboard sound quality is superb, an upgrade over earlier circulating sources [9][12]
- **gd72-03-27.aud.hanno.15816.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 173 min; rated 2.8/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: The audience recording's sound quality is described as dodgy; Audience recording has low vocals, grainy sound, and crowd loud in the mix, making the music hard to listen to [5][6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer's first Dead show; they sat in the balcony after John Sebastian tickets sold out at Ticketron [7]
- Hell's Angels were reportedly beating people up outside before the show started [7]
- The onstage chatter is described as rollicking and full of energy [13]
- Reviewer finds no second-set jam sequence and doubts it ranks among the top fifty shows of 1972 [12]
- Reviewer calls it one of the happiest and best Pig Pen shows, despite lacking jams [13]
- No Dark Star or The Other One appears, yet the reviewer finds the playing tight [14]
- Reviewer hears it as a warm-up for the Europe tour, less engaged than other Academy of Music shows [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-03-27.135871.sbd.miller.flac48**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) [1]
- **gd1972-03-27.132366.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Apogee AD500 -> Dat (48k) [2]. Also: The soundboard transfer is credited to Charlie Miller and described as crisp [15]
- **gd72-03-27.aud.hanno.15816.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [17]
- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_90.html) [18]
